prompt.original: We're an AI onboarding assistant for HR teams at the early growth stage with some PMF in the mid-market segment. Our goal is to increase WAU by 30% in the next 90 days, focused on the mid-market segment. We have limited engineering resources (2 developers) and all tactics must be brand-safe. We believe our best growth lever is our HRIS integrations (we're listed on several HRIS marketplaces). Please design a growth loop, map the full loop mechanics, identify the key bottlenecks, and propose the first 2-3 experiments we should run.
